ja.title: ゲムシタビンの点滴時間を変える：血中AUCと細胞内曝露は同じ判断につながるか
ja.summary: 同量の点滴を公開PopPKモデルの固定効果で比較し、血漿ピーク、PBMC内dFdCTP、形成CLの仮定、観測後の尾部を点検する。臨床的な点滴条件の推奨や腫瘍内曝露の予測は行わない。
ja.seo_title: ゲムシタビンの点滴時間を変える：血中AUCと細胞内曝露

english.title: Gemcitabine infusion duration: plasma AUC and intracellular exposure
english.summary: A fixed-effect plasma/PBMC subsystem from a published clinical model is implemented independently. Equal doses give equal plasma AUC, while PBMC AUC differences are determined by a categorical formation-clearance assumption. Constant-formation and tail scenarios clarify limits; no tumor, clinical benefit, safety or regimen recommendation is inferred.
